executive_pulse: CISA added CVE-2026-129448 to KEV; Cisco nginx RCEs remain unpatched in production. Rackspace Spot breach exposed Kubernetes secrets; AI agent TTPs and detection tooling are the primary new signals.
notes: CVE-2026-129448 status changed: added to KEV. CVE-2026-113425 is an update: Cisco PSIRT advisory published with fixed versions.

items.headline: CISA KEV: CVE-2026-129448 (VMware vCenter)
items.summary: CISA added CVE-2026-129448 to KEV on 2026-11-20. CVSS 9.8. Deserialization of untrusted data. Active exploitation confirmed.
items.action: Patch VMware vCenter immediately. Due date 2026-11-23.

compensating_controls: Restrict the device's management interface to an admin network; check for new admin accounts and config changes
Block or filter untrusted network access to the affected endpoint (WAF rule or network ACL)
Run the service with least privilege and no outbound internet access where possible
remediation.verify: Hunt for unexpected child processes spawned by the application server process

items.headline: Cisco nginx RCEs (CVE-2026-113425 et al.)
items.summary: Cisco PSIRT advisory released for multiple nginx RCEs affecting Cisco products. Fixed in nginx 1.31.9 (mainline) and 1.30.7 (stable). 37 public PoCs.
items.action: Upgrade nginx to 1.31.9 or 1.30.7 in all Cisco-affected deployments.

compensating_controls: Remove internet exposure of the affected interface until patched
Apply WAF or IPS signatures from your vendor for the CVE, in blocking mode
Run the service as a non-privileged user and restrict outbound connections
remediation.verify: Hunt for shells or scripting engines spawned by the affected service, and new scheduled tasks or cron entries

items.headline: Rackspace Spot breach exposes Kubernetes secrets
items.summary: Rackspace confirmed hackers breached Spot using compromised credentials, deploying unauthorized workloads and accessing Kubernetes secrets in customer clusters.
items.action: Audit Rackspace Spot access logs for unauthorized workload deployments and secret access.
items.hunt: Kubernetes audit logs: unauthorized workload creation or secret access from unexpected identities.

compensating_controls: Reduce exposure: remove internet access to the affected service or interface until patched
Apply vendor-provided mitigations or IPS/WAF signatures where published
remediation.verify: Confirm the installed version on every instance after patching

items.headline: China-linked AI agents exploit MONAI Label zero-day
items.summary: Amazon Threat Intelligence reports China-linked actors used autonomous AI agents to find and exploit a zero-day in MONAI Label, gaining root access to a university server.
items.action: Update MONAI Label to latest version. Restrict file write permissions in default setup.

compensating_controls: Reduce exposure: remove internet access to the affected service or interface until patched
Apply vendor-provided mitigations or IPS/WAF signatures where published
remediation.verify: Confirm the installed version on every instance after patching

items.headline: OpenRouter drops providers after prompt theft
items.summary: Dragos researchers found months of prompt theft at three AI inference providers routed through OpenRouter. Some stolen requests were flagged as Zero Data Retention.
items.action: Review OpenRouter provider contracts and data retention settings. Audit prompt logs for exfiltration.

compensating_controls: Restrict the device's management interface to an admin network; check for new admin accounts and config changes
Reduce exposure: remove internet access to the affected service or interface until patched
Apply vendor-provided mitigations or IPS/WAF signatures where published

items.headline: ThreatDefence/agentic-attack-detections
items.target: Microsoft Sentinel, Defender XDR, Splunk, Elastic
items.summary: Detection rules and IOCs for AI agent attack frameworks: ARTEX, Cairn, PentAGI, HexStrike, CyberStrikeAI, Strix, Hermes Agent, Agent Zero. KQL, Sigma, Suricata, Zeek, YARA, Splunk, Elastic, STIX 2.1.
items.action: Deploy relevant KQL/Sigma rules for detected AI agent TTPs.

items.headline: tracebit-com/turingpot
items.summary: Open-source AI agent honeypot PoC for investigating ARTEX and other autonomous offensive frameworks. Cloudflare Workers.
items.action: Evaluate for deployment in isolated lab to detect autonomous agent probing.

items.headline: spacesky-cell/TwinFix
items.summary: AI agent that diagnoses, reproduces and fixes bugs in a disposable twin environment. Docker-based.
items.action: Review for automated repair capabilities in CI/CD pipelines.
